projects.notes: AgiBot G2. Complete: all 37 task-group datasets of the release. MOBILE: the release records the base as a SLAM pose (state/robot position + orientation) and G2 drives 20+ m within an episode on the IL tasks; T_map_base is folded into the world-frame camera trajectories (world = base@t0, yaw-only anchor). Per-frame T_base_cam is shipped, so there is no FK. The base pose is not exported as a state column

overlays.review_note: Both cameras (D455 main, D405 attached) are image/CAD fits with assumed intrinsics (the authors' nominal D455 pinhole; a D405 focal of 375 px selected by a connector-silhouette sweep), not device calibration. The D405 pose is a connector-silhouette candidate: 2.0 px median / 11.4 px p90 connector error on 108 frozen-test frames from 36 unused episodes; its depth along the optical axis is uncertain by about 1 cm. The installed finger pads are larger than the CAD fingers, so the drawn finger outlines are not accurate and fingertip acceptance is unmeasured. The jaw width is inferred per frame from the jaw markers (12 mm label scale assumption plus an inferred pad allowance), not a released channel.
